usageNotes: Runs `apt-get update` on the target node to refresh its package index from configured APT sources; call this before checking for available upgrades or listing packages. The operation is asynchronous — the returned string is a UPID (Proxmox task ID) that you must poll with the task-status endpoint to confirm completion. The calling token or user requires `Sys.Modify` on `/nodes/{node}`.

examples.summary: Refresh package index on node 'pve1', suppressing progress output

tips: The returned UPID looks like 'UPID:pve1:...' — pass it to GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status to check when the update finishes.
Set notify=true only when you want Proxmox to generate an internal notification about newly available packages; it does not trigger an upgrade.
Run this before calling the apt/updates list endpoint (GET /nodes/{node}/apt/updates) to ensure results reflect the current upstream state.
In large clusters, you must call this per-node — there is no cluster-wide apt update endpoint.
